中文 · panel plugin v0.3.0 · skill v0.3.0"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-plugin-control-your-capture` is a DSH host plugin. It hands two capture abilities directly to t"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"he agent: **screenshots** (display / window / region) and **screen recording** (a display or a physi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"cal-pixel region on a single-display Windows console session). Capture happens at physical pixels an"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"d **never upscales**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It solves concrete "look at this / record this" problems: capturing at logical pixels on a high-DPI "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"screen makes text soft, and post-processing cannot restore it; hand-written ffmpeg commands tend to "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"pick up low-frame-rate fallbacks, overwrite files and leave stray processes. The plugin puts both pa"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ths behind controlled tool calls with structured failures."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Intended for agents and users who need reliable, sharp screen evidence inside DSH, or a decodable MP"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"4 of a session. **Not for**: offscreen page rendering, video editing, or audio capture."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Three tools, one execution path**: `capture_screenshot`, `capture_probe`, `capture_recording`; t"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"he skill contains no scripts and there is no second capture implementation.
- **Native physical pixe"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ls**: captures at the size the backend reports; `maxWidth` may downscale exactly once and the tool *"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"*never upscales**. Measured here on a 3072x1920 display at 200% scaling.
- **Two sizes, kept distinc"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"t**: `width` / `height` are the file on disk, `image.width` / `image.height` are what the model sees"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"; a downscale surfaces as `model_image_downscaled`.
- **Recording with a quality gate**: fixed `libx"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"264` / `veryfast` / CRF 14 / `yuv420p` / `+faststart`, no audio; `stop` runs FFprobe (`-count_frames"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"`) plus a full decode and refuses to publish on failure.
- **Atomic and no-clobber**: same-directory"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" hidden unique temp file; publishing never overwrites, a taken name becomes `out_renamed`.
- **Struc"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"tured failures**: every failure carries `code` / `message` / `details` / `hint`; nothing degrades si"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"lently.
- **Zero runtime dependencies**: Node built-ins only; FFmpeg / FFprobe are explicitly probed"},{"id":"p8s12","text":" external capabilities, and missing them only affects recording."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The same screen region at the same moment, changing only the sampling resolution (left: physical pix"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"els 800x500; right: logical pixels 400x250 upscaled 2x):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Support matrix"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Grades: `stable` has real-machine evidence plus image review; `beta` is complete but only partly mea"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"sured; `experimental` has no real-machine evidence; `unsupported` is rejected explicitly, never sile"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ntal` has no real-machine evidence; `unsupported` is rejected explicitly, never silently downgraded."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Platform / session | Shot display | Shot window | Shot region | Rec display | Rec region |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Windows 10/11 console (single display) | beta | beta | beta | **beta** | **beta** |

- Only measured platform x target pairs get promoted; **no platform is "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"claimed to work everywhere**."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Requirement: DSH installed. The plugin itself has no runtime dependency; **recording additionally ne"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"eds an external FFmpeg (with the `ddagrab` filter and `libx264`) and FFprobe** — screenshots do not."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- A fresh bundle can take effect through HMR; **replacing an installed package requires a DSH restar"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"t** to load the new module.
- On mount it registers three tools and installs the thin `capture-sharp"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"` guidance skill into the global skill directory (default `$DSH_HOME/skills`).
- To check the enviro"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"nment, have the agent call `capture_probe` and read `targets`, `recording.missing` and whether the o"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"utput root is writable."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Screenshots: capture_screenshot"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Parameter | Values | Notes |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| `target` | `display` / `window` / `region` | Defaults to `display`; no `all` |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Recording is limited to `display` / `region` on a **single-display Windows console**: no audio, no"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" window / multi-display / HDR / RDP / session 0, and no recording on macOS or Linux; `yuv420p` is lo"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ssy and **not pixel-identical to PNG**, with no lossless mode.
- Recording needs external FFmpeg / F"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"Fprobe (`ddagrab` + `libx264`): when missing the call fails with `backend_unavailable` and lists eac"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"h item in `missing`; nothing is downloaded or bundled.
- After a **hard kill** (crash / force-quit) "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"orphan FFmpeg processes and `.tmp-*.mp4` files are not guaranteed to be cleaned (0.3.0 has no Job Ob"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ject).
- `start` means "the process is alive and the temp file is non-empty (header)"; FFmpeg output"},{"id":"p24s8","text":" buffering can keep video data off disk until `stop`, and delivery quality is enforced by the `stop`"},{"id":"p24s9","text":" FFprobe + full-decode validation.
- `target:"window"` can return a blank image for some GPU-composi"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"ted windows (`PrintWindow` cannot reach the compositor layer); the result then carries `content_unif"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"orm` — switch to `display` or `region`.
- macOS / Linux screenshots have no real-machine evidence an"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"d stay `experimental`; Wayland may prompt for permission."}],"truncated":true}
